verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Azure REST APIs and client libraries, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on learn.microsoft.com returned 404, and API Management's ability to publish customer APIs is an adjacent feature, not Azure's own API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
